query:
UPDATE weekly_score_picks SET (id, 
target_account_id, 
created_by_account_id, 
starts_at, 
ends_at, 
created_at) = ((CASE $2::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $3 ELSE id END), (CASE $4::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $5 ELSE target_account_id END), (CASE $6::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $7 ELSE created_by_account_id END), (CASE $8::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $9 ELSE starts_at END), (CASE $10::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $11 ELSE ends_at END), (CASE $12::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $13 ELSE created_at END)) WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id as "id!: i32", 
target_account_id as "target_account_id!: String", 
created_by_account_id as "created_by_account_id!: Option < String >", 
starts_at as "starts_at!: UtcDateTime", 
ends_at as "ends_at!: UtcDateTime", 
created_at as "created_at!: UtcDateTime"
